_comment: Host allowlist for scripts/browser-tool.mjs. Navigation to non-listed hosts fails — Julius adds hosts by editing this file manually. Wildcard subdomain via *.domain.com. Example: to allow a grocery store later add "staterbros.com" and "*.staterbros.com" to allowedHosts. blockedClickPatterns gate destructive clicks unless --confirm is passed. sensitiveFieldPatterns drive value masking in all output.
